watches.name: Vostok Amphibia 020 with Seiko mods
watches.description: Vostok Amphibia 020 41 x 48, 20mm lugs 200m WR (20 ATM) Friction bezel Boxed hesalite crystal Free tracked shipping This 020 case Vostok Amphibia has been modded with some rather well suited Seiko details. It’s a lovely little workhorse with all the quirks we’ve come to love from Vostok. The 020 case measures 41x48mm with 20mm lugs. The Seiko style friction bezel really brings this watch to the next level. It’s fitted with a signed Vostok bracelet but looks just as good on a nato or leather strap. The movement runs beautifully accurate at around -3s/day. This watch has been used and as such has a few scratches here and there on the case, crystal and bracelet. It’s sold as seen so please inspect the pictures carefully. No box or papers with this one.

watches.name: Vertigo Pilot One
watches.description: Vertigo Pilot One 41 x 48.5 x 13, 22 lugs Seagull ST19 , +16s/day 100m WR Flat sapphire crystal Free tracked shipping Vertigo is an Italian micro brand who mainly makes vintage inspired divers. With the Pilot One, they took strong inspiration from vintage chronos, perhaps most clearly from the 1960s Zenith Cairelli CP-2 (which Zenith re-editioned as the Cronometro in 2016), but Heuer Bundeswehr springs to mind as well. I love the vintage look and the combination of a chronograph and dive bezel. Mouth watering! Comes with original box and papers. The leather strap is like new as I’ve always wore it with other straps. This watch has been used and as such has a few scratches here and there on the case. The movement works fine, including the chronograph. The pushers could do with some lube though as they don’t spring back into place automatically after pushing them. You have to pull them back into neutral position. It’s sold as seen so please inspect the pictures carefully. A video review can be seen here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yJ3T42B2Otg

watches.name: Aquatico Aqua One – Blue sunburst dial and snowflake hands
watches.description: Aquatico Aqua One 42 x 50 x 12.6, 22 lugs Seiko NH36, -10s/day 300m WR Flat sapphire crystal Free tracked shipping One of Aquatico’s early endeavours is this fine piece taking inspiration from both Rolex’ Submariner and Explorer, topped off with snowflake hands for good measure! I got to love the completely shameless mix’n’match and this watch has seen a lot of wrist time over the years. It also features the infamous ‘mermaid on a dolphin’ case back etching. This watch has been used and as such has a few scratches here and there on the case and the crystal. It’s sold as seen so please inspect the pictures carefully. Comes with original box and papers. Watch a video review of the Acqua One here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D2TFjfo0oJo

watches.name: Venturo Skindiver with date
watches.description: Venturo Skindiver by Gruppo Gamma. 41 x 48.5 x 12, 22 lugs Miyota 9015, -5s/day 200m WR Box sapphire crystal Free tracked shipping Gruppo Gamma Divemaster was one of my first mechanical watches. And boy did I like that watch. I guess it represents something special to me also because of the time in my life when I wore it. But 44mm eventually outgrew me and it saw less wrist time. The Divemaster carries a lot of the Divemaster DNA but in a smaller, and beautifully sculptured case. It’s a lot more refined, yet has that bold tool feel that most Gruppo Gamma watches have. It has one of the best lume I’ve ever seen and is great on both the bracelet and on a nato strap. This watch has been used and as such has a few scratches here and there on the bracelet, a tiny dent in the crystal at 58 and a small dent in the bezel at 36. It’s sold as seen so please inspect the pictures carefully. It’s in a very good shape though, I should say. More info here: https://gruppogammawatches.com/collections/skindiver

watches.name: WOLBROOK / DOUGLAS SKINDIVER WT PROFESSIONAL
watches.description: DOUGLAS SKINDIVER WT PROFESSIONAL by Wolbrook 40 x 48 x 13, 20 lugs Miyota 8215, +2s/day 100m WR Domed acrylic crystal Free tracked shipping A beautiful rugged retro classic look that has served me well on some good adventures. Since the day I spotted an 80’s PVD Heuer Regatta on a colleague’s wrist in 2018 I’ve been hooked on the PVD on bracelet look. I still like and wear this one a lot but to keep my collection in motion I’m willing to let it go. This watch comes with all original boxes, papers and accessories as seen in the photos. It’s been used and as such there are a few scratches on the acrylic and a tiny dent in the bezel around 12:30. The white hour markers in the bezel have been a bit discoloured from the sun and picked up a white-beige tint. More info about the watch from Wolbrook’s own site here: https://wolbrook.com/collections/skindiver-wt-professional-tool-watch/products/skindiver-wt-professional-bracelet-tool-watch-black-pvd

watches.name: Clipper
watches.description: Free shipping within Europe Clipper was designed for the good life connoisseurs. Exploration-hungry globetrotters in constant search of the next fine pleasure. The name is shared with the most iconic seaplane of all times – the Boeing 314 Clipper. Take the road less traveled and find your moments. Clipper is a tribute to a lost era of glamour and adventure. Wear it wherever you go to remind you that your moments are out there – all you need to do is to find them. Bamboo is an organic material – each watch has its unique shade and grain pattern. With time your watch will grow a beautiful patina and take on a darker tint. Learn how Clipper and Catalina got produced in this article on Behance.net Designed in London, UK by Martin Sandstrom Produced in Shenzhen, China Material 100% Natural bamboo for the body and links Material Stainless steel clasp Movement Quartz 2035 by Miyota (Citizen) Water resistance 3ATM “splash proof” Case dimensions 46 x 52 x 10 mm Fits on wrists around 17 – 24 cm Warranty 2 years limited

watches.name: Catalina
watches.description: Free shipping within Europe Catalina’s design is inspired by the flight instruments of airplanes and has got its name from the American WW2 flying boat PBY Catalina. A style statement as strong as the bamboo it’s made of. Take the road less traveled and find your moments. Catalina has got its name from the American WW2 flying boat PBY Catalina – arguably the most versatile and loved seaplane in the world. Catalina was used by the American forces as a scouting, bomber and rescue plane, and continued its duties as a civil aircraft long after the war ended. Catalina is a tribute to a lost era of exploration and adventure, where the seaplanes enabled us to reach unexplored corners of the world.
